# brig sandbox snapshot create

Take a snapshot of a sandbox's /sandbox

## Synopsis

```text
brig sandbox snapshot create [VM] SANDBOX [-w W] [--yes]
```

## Description

Copy the /sandbox of SANDBOX into a new snapshot, SANDBOX@TIME. A ready
sandbox is stopped for the copy, so that no file changes during it, and
started again; whatever runs in it ends. If an agent or another program
runs in it, brig names it and asks first; -y/--yes skips the question.
Without a terminal, brig refuses then, unless --yes. A stopped sandbox stays
stopped.

brig warns when the snapshot holds a file with a real credential, as /login
inside a sandbox leaves it.

## Examples

```sh
brig sandbox snapshot create dev webapp
brig sandbox snapshot create webapp -w team --yes
```

## Options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-w, --workspace string` | the workspace of the gateway to work in (default: $BRIG\_WORKSPACE, else default) |
| `-y, --yes` | stop the sandbox without asking, also when a program runs in it |

The [global options](brig.md#options) of brig apply too.
